purpose: Describe a manner, appearance, or way of doing something.
keywords: こんな / そんな / あんな / どんな + ふうに; clause + ふうに
Please fold the corner like this.
How could I explain it so it gets across?
I am sorry if that sounded as though I was blaming you.
formation: こんな / そんな / あんな / どんな + ふうに; clause + ふうに
restrictions: ふう refers to manner; ふうな modifies a noun.
mistake: Use に before a predicate and な before a noun.
